I found nothing that makes the two relations equal unconditionally.

CloseAt T is the specLib/templateLibrary relation, whose multiplication height certificate calls ndep's poleTemplate (Route K curves x(x-l)(x+l)) for every T, while [M]'s certificate calls Phi for x(x-l)(x+3l); so it is another polynomial, with [M]'s semantics only under ndep's MultiplicationExact.
